A fourth-wall-breaking legal comedy that explores identity, fame, and what it means to be a hero in a world already filled with superheroes.

title: Ms Marvel
description: Follows Kamala Khan, a teenager from Jersey City who gains mysterious cosmic abilities after discovering a powerful ancient bangle connected to her family's history. Explores Kamala's journey from a superhero fan idolising Captain Marvel into becoming a hero in her own right. Introduces Kamala's unique powers and reveals their connection to the Clandestines, an ancient group of beings with ties to another dimension. Introduces the concept of Noor energy and explores connections between different dimensions. Explores Kamala's family, culture, and heritage, including the history of her ancestors and the impact of Partition on her family. Focuses on identity, family, belonging, and discovering what kind of hero someone wants to become

title: Thor: Love and Thunder
description: Follows Thor as he attempts to find a new purpose after the events of Endgame, stepping away from his life as an Avenger and searching for inner peace. Introduces Gorr the God Butcher, who seeks to eliminate all gods after experiencing tragedy and losing faith in them. Re-explores Thor's relationship with Jane Foster, who returns after years away and becomes the new wielder of Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Explores the existence of gods (such as Zeus, Hercules, and the being known as Eternity) across the universe, the idea of a pantheon of powerful beings, and the consequences of their actions. Further develops Thor's character by focusing on grief, love, loss, and learning that being a hero is about more than just having power.

title: Werewolf By Night
description: Follows Jack Russell, a monster hunter with a dark secret, as he joins a group of hunters competing in a deadly ritual to claim a powerful relic. Reveals Jack's true identity as the Werewolf by Night, a powerful creature struggling to control his monstrous nature. Introduces Elsa Bloodstone, a skilled monster hunter who returns to her family's legacy and challenges the traditions of the Bloodstone hunting clan. Explores the Bloodstone, an ancient supernatural artefact with connections to powerful monsters and mystical forces. A darker, horror-inspired Marvel story that pays homage to classic monster films while opening the door for more supernatural storytelling within the MCU.

title: Guardians of The Galaxy: Holiday Special
description: Follows the Guardians of the Galaxy as they celebrate Christmas together on Knowhere, with Mantis and Drax attempting to cheer up Peter Quill after the events of Avengers: Endgame and his continued grief over Gamora. Focuses on Mantis and Drax as they travel to Earth in search of a special gift for Peter, leading them into a chaotic adventure involving Kevin Bacon. Develops the relationships within the Guardians, particularly Mantis and Peter Quill, while exploring themes of friendship, family, and belonging. A light-hearted Christmas special that provides character moments and emotional setup for the Guardians' next chapter

title: Ant-Man and The Wasp: Quantum Mania
description: Follows Scott Lang, Hope van Dyne, Cassie Lang, Hank Pym, and Janet van Dyne as they are pulled into the Quantum Realm, where they discover a vast hidden civilisation and a dangerous new threat. Expands the Quantum Realm by revealing it as a massive interconnected world with its own societies, creatures, and history beyond anything previously known. Introduces Kang the Conqueror, a powerful multiversal being whose knowledge of time and alternate realities makes him one of the MCU's biggest emerging threats. Explores Janet van Dyne's decades trapped in the Quantum Realm and reveals the secrets she kept about what she encountered there. Develops Cassie Lang as she begins her own journey toward becoming a superhero, inspired by the legacy of her father.

title: Guardians of The Galaxy: Volume Three
description: Follows the Guardians as they face a devastating threat when Rocket's traumatic past comes back to haunt them, forcing the team to go on a mission to save him. Explores Rocket's origins and reveals the experiments conducted on him by the High Evolutionary, expanding the character's history and emotional journey. Introduces the High Evolutionary, a scientist obsessed with creating the perfect species and responsible for many of the galaxy's greatest atrocities. Further develops the Guardians as a family while exploring themes of friendship, trauma, acceptance, and the importance of protecting those who cannot protect themselves. Acts as the conclusion to James Gunn's Guardians trilogy, bringing closure to the original team's journey while leaving the door open for future Guardians stories. An emotional finale focused on Rocket's story and the idea that family is not defined by where someone comes from, but by the people who choose to stand beside them.

title: Secret Invasion
description: Follows Nick Fury as he returns to Earth after years away and discovers that a faction of Skrulls has secretly infiltrated powerful positions across the planet. Explores the Skrulls' struggle for a permanent home after the promise made to them by Fury and Carol Danvers, revealing the consequences of years of waiting for a solution. Introduces Gravik, a radical Skrull leader who believes humanity has failed them and begins a dangerous plan to force Earth to surrender. Expands the spy and political side of the MCU by exploring infiltration, distrust, identity, and the difficulty of knowing who can truly be trusted. A darker espionage-focused story that explores the consequences of hidden threats operating within a world still recovering from the events of the Infinity Saga.

title: The Marvels
description: Follows Carol Danvers (Captain Marvel), Kamala Khan (Ms. Marvel), and Monica Rambeau as their powers become mysteriously linked, causing them to swap places whenever they use their abilities. Continues Kamala Khan's story after Ms. Marvel, showing her transition from an aspiring hero into a more experienced member of the superhero community. Develops Monica Rambeau after her introduction in WandaVision, exploring her connection to cosmic energy and her complicated relationship with Carol Danvers. Introduces Dar-Benn, a Kree revolutionary seeking to restore her home world by using powerful technology connected to the Quantum Bands. Expands the Kree / Skrull conflict introduced in Captain Marvel, while exploring the consequences of past decisions made by Carol and the wider cosmic community. Explores identity, legacy, and the idea that heroes are stronger when they work together rather than fighting alone.

title: Agatha All Along
description: Follows Agatha Harkness after the events of WandaVision, as she attempts to regain her magical abilities and escape the spell that Wanda Maximoff placed on her. Explores the darker side of witchcraft within the MCU, expanding on the magical mythology introduced through WandaVision, Doctor Strange, and Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. Introduces a new coven of witches who join Agatha on a journey along the legendary Witches' Road, a magical realm said to grant wishes and restore what has been lost. Expands the history and rules of MCU magic, exploring different types of witches, magical traditions, and the consequences of using powerful spells.

title: Venom: The Last Dance
description: Follows Eddie Brock and Venom as they become fugitives, hunted by both human authorities and powerful enemies connected to the symbiotes' ancient origins. Expands the mythology of the symbiotes by introducing their creator, Knull, an ancient cosmic being whose influence reaches across the universe. Introduces new symbiotes and reveals more about the symbiote home-world, expanding the cosmic side of Sony's Spider-Man Universe. Continues the multiverse connections established by Spider-Man: No Way Home and Venom: Let There Be Carnage, while remaining primarily within Sony's own continuity. Serves as the conclusion to Eddie Brock and Venom's trilogy, bringing closure to their story while leaving the wider future of Sony's universe open.

title: Ironheart
description: Follows Riri Williams as she returns to Chicago and continues developing her advanced armour technology while struggling with the consequences of her choices and the legacy of those who inspired her. Expands the technological side of the MCU by exploring advanced armour, artificial intelligence, and the impact of superhuman technology in a world shaped by Wakanda and Stark Industries. Introduces the darker mystical side of the MCU through Riri's conflict with Parker Robbins (The Hood), blending science and supernatural forces, such as Mephistopheles. Continues threads from Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, particularly Riri's connection to Wakanda and the impact of her inventions on global powers. Expands the next generation of MCU heroes by introducing another young hero alongside characters such as Kamala Khan and Kate Bishop. A story about legacy, ambition, and creating your own path while stepping into a world of superheroes.

title: Daredevil: Born Again: Season One
description: Follows Matt Murdock as he continues balancing his life as a lawyer and vigilante while confronting new challenges in a changing New York City. Explores Wilson Fisk's growing political influence as he attempts to reshape New York through legitimate power while hiding his criminal ambitions. Expands the MCU's street-level world, bringing together characters and conflicts rooted in crime, corruption, and vigilante justice rather than cosmic or multiversal threats. Continues themes of justice, morality, and identity as Matt struggles with the line between the law and the actions he takes as Daredevil. A grounded crime drama that continues one of Marvel's most acclaimed character stories while building the MCU's street-level future

title: Daredevil: Born Again: Season Two
description: Continues Matt Murdock's fight to protect New York as the conflict between Daredevil and Wilson Fisk reaches new heights, forcing both men to confront the consequences of their choices. Explores Matt's ongoing struggle to balance his life as a lawyer with his role as Daredevil, as the line between justice and vengeance becomes increasingly blurred. Continues Wilson Fisk's rise to power, expanding his influence over New York while pursuing his own vision of order and control. Explores themes of justice, redemption, sacrifice, and the personal cost of protecting others. Further cements Daredevil and Kingpin as central figures in the MCU's grounded, street-level stories.

title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
description: Follows Frank Castle as he attempts to move beyond his life as the Punisher, only to be dragged back into violence when a new threat forces him to confront his past. Continues Frank's story after the original Netflix Punisher series and his return in Daredevil: Born Again, exploring the consequences of his endless war against criminals. Explores Frank's struggle between wanting a life beyond revenge and accepting that his skills and brutality make him uniquely suited to protecting others. Expands the MCU's street-level crime world by focusing on organised crime, corruption, and the darker side of New York after the rise of figures like Wilson Fisk. A brutal, character-focused story about redemption, trauma, and whether Frank Castle can ever truly escape being the Punisher.

title: Captain America: Brave New World
description: Follows Sam Wilson as he embraces the Captain America mantle while facing a global crisis that tests his ability to lead without the shield belonging to Steve Rogers. Explores Sam's role as the new Captain America, focusing on what the symbol means in a changing world and how he creates his own legacy. Introduces President Thaddeus Ross as a major figure in the MCU's political landscape, exploring his complicated relationship with superheroes and his transformation into the Red Hulk. Continues threads from The Incredible Hulk by bringing back characters and concepts connected to Bruce Banner's history. Expands the political and espionage side of the MCU, dealing with international tensions, power struggles, and threats emerging after the events of the Blip. A new chapter for Captain America that explores leadership, responsibility, and what it means to carry a symbol bigger than yourself.

title: Thunderbolts*
description: Follows a group of antiheroes that are brought together for a dangerous mission, forcing them to work as a team despite their conflicting personalities and pasts. Brings together Yelena Belova, Bucky Barnes, Red Guardian, John Walker (U.S. Agent), Ghost, Taskmaster, and Valentina Allegra de Fontaine as they navigate a mission connected to their individual histories. Explores the idea of what happens to former villains, assassins, and damaged heroes after the main Avengers era, focusing on redemption and second chances. Continues storylines from projects including Black Widow, The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, Ant-Man and the Wasp, and Captain America: Brave New World. Expands the political and espionage side of the MCU by exploring covert operations and the rise of a new kind of superhero team. Acts as a spiritual successor to the darker, street-level and spy-focused stories of the MCU, while setting up the future direction of the franchise. A team-up built around flawed characters rather than traditional heroes, exploring whether people with complicated pasts can still become something better.

title: Wonder Man
description: Follows Simon Williams, a struggling Hollywood actor who gets the chance to play the lead role in a reboot of the fictional superhero film 'Wonder Man', while discovering that his own life is becoming connected to the superhero world. Explores Simon's journey from an aspiring actor into the hero known as Wonder Man, focusing on identity, fame, and what it means to become something bigger than yourself. Brings back Trevor Slattery, continuing his story after Iron Man 3, All Hail the King: One Shot, and Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings. Expands the MCU's exploration of superheroes as a part of everyday culture, looking at the entertainment industry and how heroes are viewed by the public. A more character-driven Marvel story that blends superhero mythology with Hollywood satire, focusing on legacy, ambition, and finding your place in a world full of heroes.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: Follows Peter Parker as he begins a new chapter as Spider-Man, living alone and rebuilding his life after the sacrifice he made at the end of 'No Way Home'. Explores Peter's new reality where his friends, family, and everyone he knew no longer remember him, forcing him to redefine what being Spider-Man means without the support system he once had. Continues Peter's evolution from a young hero guided by mentors like Tony Stark into a more independent and experienced Spider-Man. Expands the street-level side of the MCU, returning Spider-Man to the grounded crime stories associated with his comic-book roots. Introduces Jean Grey into the MCU and explores themes of loneliness, responsibility, identity, and the cost of being a hero when nobody knows the person behind the mask.
